title: The Six Leg Secret
intro: This quiz follows Ava and Leo as they learn the main features that make an animal an insect.

questions.prompt: What are the three main parts of an insect's body?
questions.explanation: The three main parts of an insect's body are the head, thorax, and abdomen.

questions.prompt: Where are an insect's six legs attached?
questions.explanation: An insect's six legs are attached to the thorax.

questions.prompt: What do antennae help insects do?
questions.explanation: Antennae help insects sense the world around them.

questions.prompt: Why is a spider not an insect?
choices: It has eight legs and only two main body parts
questions.explanation: A spider is not an insect because it has eight legs and only two main body parts.

questions.prompt: Which clue best shows that a small animal is probably an insect?
choices: It has three body parts, six legs, and antennae
It has eight legs and no antennae
It has fur and four legs
questions.explanation: A small animal is probably an insect if it has three body parts, six legs, and antennae.
